messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "body's ability to clear cholesterol"
set: ["body's ability to clear cholesterol", "acts like body's stress hormone", "blocking the same pathway your kidneys use to clear metformin out of your system", "nerve cells to communicate", "binding to mu-opioid receptors", "allowing blood to flow more smoothly", "increases air flow to the lungs", "improves how the body responds to insulin", "long-term use returns blood volume to normal", "increasing the supply of blood to the heart", "normalizing chemical signals nerves send to each other", "blood vessels offer less resistance to blood flow", "helps prevent certain bacteria from becoming resistant to amoxicillin", "causes high levels of serotonin to build up in your body", "binding to the alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels in nerve cells", "affects chemicals in the brain and nerves that contribute to hyperactivity and impulse control"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
